one_liner: Fathom (fathom.ai AI notetaker) has a free-tier REST API with API keys, optional OAuth2 for multi-user apps, webhooks, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: API keys are generated per user in Settings → API Access. OAuth 2.0 authorization-code is supported for multi-account apps, but the docs say you must register an app with Fathom. It is unclear whether that is fully self-serve, so API key is primary.
access_notes: API access is included on all plans, including free. Keys are generated in User Settings → API Access with no approval step.
blocker_notes: The API is limited to meetings, summaries, transcripts, teams and webhooks. The rate limit is 60 calls per minute. Keys only see the holder's own meetings and meetings shared with their team. The search results also contain unrelated products (usefathom.com analytics, Fathom finance) that were ignored.

evidence.quote: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website’s settings area.
